metadata.author: Codex preparation agent /root/prepare_corpus
metadata.status: authored and locally checked; independent integration review pending
metadata.assignment_method: Purposive stratified authorship before tuning: three distinct development compositions and then three distinct held-out compositions per stratum. No random selection and no model-output selection. Both partitions share one author; author independence is from prompt tuning, not between designs.
metadata.source_anchor_contract: element_path is zero-based child-index path from SVG root (0); source_id is a source attribute when present, not an importer inventory ID. Evaluation must reconcile anchors to actual sanitized inventory IDs before comparing proposals.
metadata.label_status: Authored intended semantics, not observed model/runtime results; correction-count scoring must be frozen separately in the scoring-freeze phase.
limitations: One author synthetic evidence; not exporter provenance or population accuracy proof.
Original geometry is varied, but shared helper serialization, fonts and author style can correlate examples.
Human/second-author adjudication and visual/runtime fidelity are not established by XML validation.
Unknown intent is intentionally retained; artwork cannot supply quiz correctness, clock direction or playback policy.
Holdout separation here is procedural filesystem separation, not durable storage or access-control proof.
